reason: My outlets run on Google reviews and regulars, and I barely spend on marketing. A new app with no track record in my area isn't something I'll hand creator money to, free pilot or not. Signing up still costs my time and my staff's time.
objection: Nobody I know has used it, and I don't believe my counter staff will remember to tap +1 for every code, so the 'exact numbers' could just be guesses.
would_change_my_mind: Another owner on my street or in my area telling me a Mitra creator brought them a real, countable rush of customers.
